timezone: Source naive timestamps assumed America/Sao_Paulo (IANA DST); source_subset preserves original strings.
fx_authority: fixed demo assumption, not current FX
money: Decimal ROUND_HALF_UP per item component; checkout total=sum transformed items; payments converted independently; discrepancies reported.
selection: Top 40 sellers by distinct checkouts, stable seller_id tie-break; keep ALL items and other sellers in each selected checkout.
identity: customer_unique_id buyer key; per-buyer tokens except declared same-city cohorts. Dorm shares address only.
address: One invented VN address per buyer/cohort; invented SIM ward codes, full and abbreviation variants. Not a geocoded/routable address.
cod: 65% deterministic checkout assignment, scenario overrides; boleto remains boleto in raw.
outcomes: Target 10% of all COD shop-orders fail. Weighted latent cohort/region risk + seeded noise; source delivered time retained; scenario overrides disclosed.
pending: No terminal event for purchases in last 3 days or outcomes beyond as_of. Known malformed source chronology quarantined.
account_age: 10% new (<7d), others sampled empirical account_age_days; all before first checkout.

return_abuse.usage: Aggregate parameter guidance only. No row/customer joins; return rate is not COD failure rate.

scenarios: Chosen real checkout times/items; only identities, COD, age and outcomes overridden. Evaluation-only authored cases, not independent benchmark.
raw_unknowns: No registration, phone, device, household address, verified resolutions or canceled event time invented in raw; derived IDs/shop labels and workflow states documented.
